programme.desc: Monster Jam Fast Track ignites the night at loneDepot Park in Miami for a high-stakes Round 7 of the Stadium Championship Series East. The evening culminates in a chaotic Freestyle segment, where 12,000-pound machines like Mayhem and Sparkle Smash are pushed to their absolute limits, facing mechanical failures and spectacular "big air" moments in pursuit of the Miami crown.
